title: Silicon Studio project
description: Configuration of a Silicon Studio digital design project.

top.description: Top-level module for linting, synthesis and equivalence checking.

sources.description: RTL files, folders (all .v/.sv inside) or globs such as "rtl/**/*.sv", relative to this file.

includeDirs.description: Extra `include search directories. Folders that contain sources are searched automatically.

defines.description: Preprocessor macros (`define) passed to every tool. true defines without a value, false omits the macro.

parameters.description: Parameter overrides for the top module (lint, synthesis and equivalence).

timeoutSeconds.description: Simulation is stopped after this many seconds.

engine.description: Lint engine; auto prefers Verilator, then Icarus Verilog. Yosys elaboration checks always run when Yosys is available.

severity.description: Override the severity of diagnostics by code, e.g. { "UNUSEDSIGNAL": "off", "WIDTHTRUNC": "error" }.

abc.description: Run ABC logic optimization and mapping.

liberty.description: Liberty (.lib) standard-cell library for technology mapping and area. Without it, only generic gate statistics are reported.

extraCommands.description: Additional Yosys commands run after mapping (shell and script commands are not allowed).

constraints.description: SDC timing constraint files (included in snapshots and exports).

source.description: Where the library data comes from (provenance).

reset.description: Reset input asserted in the first cycle of the bounded counterexample search. Default: a port named rst, reset, rst_n, ...

resetActiveLow.description: Whether the reset is active low. Default: true for names ending in _n/n or starting with n.

platform.description: Process platform: nangate45 (FreePDK45 + Nangate Open Cell Library) or sky130hd (SkyWater 130 nm high-density cells).

utilization.description: Target core utilization in percent (cell area / core area). Ignored when dieArea is set.

coreMargin.description: Space between core and die edge in microns.

dieArea.description: Fixed die rectangle [x0, y0, x1, y1] in microns (overrides utilization).

coreArea.description: Fixed core rectangle [x0, y0, x1, y1] in microns, inside dieArea.

placeDensity.description: Global placement target density (default: platform value).

pinConstraints.description: Place IO pins on a die side.

items.description: Placement blockage [x0, y0, x1, y1] in microns.

blockages.description: Areas where no standard cells may be placed.

scenarios.description: Named floorplan variants for "Explore Floorplan Scenarios"; each overrides the settings above.

utilization.description: Target core utilization in percent (cell area / core area). Ignored when dieArea is set.

coreMargin.description: Space between core and die edge in microns.

dieArea.description: Fixed die rectangle [x0, y0, x1, y1] in microns (overrides utilization).

coreArea.description: Fixed core rectangle [x0, y0, x1, y1] in microns, inside dieArea.

placeDensity.description: Global placement target density (default: platform value).

pinConstraints.description: Place IO pins on a die side.

items.description: Placement blockage [x0, y0, x1, y1] in microns.

blockages.description: Areas where no standard cells may be placed.

activeScenario.description: Scenario used by "Run Place & Route" (default: the settings above).
